elsewhere.note: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew pillows on all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls!…
